question: For Zepto, find its current head of engineering, when they joined, and where they worked before.
answer: The evidence identifies Nikhil Mittal, Zepto’s Chief Technology Officer, as the senior executive leading its engineering and technology organization. He became CTO in January 2024 after serving as Zepto’s VP/SVP of Engineering. The provided evidence does not establish when he originally joined Zepto or where he worked before Zepto, so those details cannot be answered without guessing. I preferred Mittal’s own website because it is the most direct cited source, although it is rated tier 4.

**Zepto’s current technology/engineering leadership:**

- **Nikhil Mittal — Chief Technology Officer (CTO).** He has held the CTO role since **January 2024**, after serving as Zepto’s VP/SVP of Engineering. He is the senior executive leading the company’s engineering and technology organization. ([mittalnikhil.com](https://mittalnikhil.com/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Kaivalya Vohra — Co-founder & President, Technology & Product.** Vohra previously held the CTO title; following Mittal’s appointment, the technology, product, analytics, and data-science functions were consolidated under his broader leadership. ([hirezapp.com](https://www.hirezapp.com/careers/zepto?utm_source=openai))  
- **Koushik Kottamasu — Senior Director, Engineering.** A publicly featured senior engineering leader in Zepto’s engineering organization. ([linkedin.com](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/nikhilkmittal_zeptoengineering-zeptoleadeship-activity-7360885958755405826-jrf_?utm_source=openai))  
- **Karthic Somalinga — SVP, Engineering, Fulfillment.** Leads engineering related to fulfillment, based on current organizational listings. ([theorg.com](https://theorg.com/org/zeptonow/person/nikhil-mittal?utm_source=openai))  
- **Qamar Ali Shaikh — VP, Infrastructure Platform Engineering** and **Suthakar Loganathan — Head of IT & Security Engineering.** ([theorg.com](https://theorg.com/org/zeptonow/person/nikhil-mittal?utm_source=openai))  

So if you mean the overall **head of engineering / CTO**, the answer is **Nikhil Mittal**.

Assuming you mean **Karthic Somalinga**, Zepto’s engineering leader for fulfillment:

- **Appointment / joining date:** He joined **Zepto in October 2023** as **VP, Engineering – Fulfillment**; Zepto has since described him publicly as **Vice President – Engineering**. ([theorg.com](https://theorg.com/org/zeptonow/person/karthic-somalinga?utm_source=openai))  
- **Previous roles:** Before Zepto, he was **Head of Engineering, Lending at Grab** (April 2019–October 2023), where he worked on Grab PayLater and lending products. Earlier, he held engineering-leadership positions at **Ninjacart** and **Swiggy**, and worked at **Microsoft** (Bing Ads), **Yahoo!**, and **CA**. ([theorg.com](https://theorg.com/org/zeptonow/person/karthic-somalinga?utm_source=openai))
